head: Google Fi now switches between two networks, fully on Pixel 9 and newer
dek: Google Fi now uses two carriers' networks and switches phones to the stronger signal, calling it a "super network". Getting the full benefit needs a Pixel 9 or newer.
details: Google hasn't named the second carrier; PCMag's coverage checks suggest Verizon alongside T-Mobile. It recalls Project Fi, which switched between networks a decade ago.
means: Fi customers with a recent Pixel may get signal in places where T-Mobile alone was weak.
todo: Check Fi's coverage map for where you live; the switching needs a Pixel 9 or newer.
